name: People Trace UK

search.notes: The people search posts a form to Electoral_Roll_Search.asp, so there is no simple GET URL. Search by first name, surname and town on the home page.

steps: Open the Record Removal page on peopletraceuk.com.
Enter full name and date of birth.
Enter the email address and phone number for contact.
Enter the flat number, building, street, town and postcode of the record.
Submit the form. Use one form per person and per address.
Watch for an identity check email and answer it.
optout.notes: The page says removals for an identified and verified data subject are completed within 5 working days, and that the site may contact the person to confirm identity. Data is based on the electoral roll, so also do gb-open-register.

sources.attribution: People Trace UK record removal page

verification_note: Removal page loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 and describes the form and the 5 working day timeline.
